title: SlideContentSchema
description: Output contract for the Slide Understanding stage. Contains extracted content for every unique slide.

total_cost_usd.description: Cumulative vision API cost for this run's understanding stage.

budget_ceiling_usd.description: Budget ceiling that was in effect. 0 means no ceiling was configured.

slides.description: One entry per unique slide_id. Not per occurrence — de-duplicated.

title.description: Slide title extracted from the frame. Empty string if none detected.

bullets.description: Bullet point texts in document order. Empty array if no bullets.

visual_description.description: Plain-language description of charts, diagrams, or images. Empty string if text-only slide.

raw_ocr.description: All visible text on the slide in reading order.

extraction_method.description: 'vision' if extracted via Claude vision API; 'ocr' if extracted via Tesseract fallback.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated API cost for this single slide extraction. 0.0 for OCR extractions.
